external_entities.name: duty engineer
external_entities.description: An engineer who opens the dispatch console in a browser.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

external_entities.name: scheduling partner
external_entities.description: Another company that publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company, publishes tomorrow's planned work.

processes.name: corporate web host
processes.description: Serves the single-page JavaScript dispatch console.
processes.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it

processes.name: dispatch console
processes.description: A single-page JavaScript application used by duty engineers.
processes.source_excerpt: The console is a single-page JavaScript app
processes.notes: The source does not state how an engineer signs in to it.

processes.name: dispatch API
processes.description: The API called by the dispatch console and schedule importer.
processes.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
processes.notes: The control plane is not reachable from the internet.

processes.name: schedule importer
processes.description: Pulls the scheduling partner's SOAP feed, parses its XML, and posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: Our schedule importer runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The importer presents an API token that was issued when it was built and has not been rotated.

processes.name: corporate file store
processes.description: The corporate file store containing the schedule archive folder.
processes.source_excerpt: a folder on the corporate file store

data_stores.name: dispatch database
data_stores.description: Stores job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That database holds the job orders, the crew names and the crew mobile numbers.
data_stores.notes: Every job order carries the token or session that created it, and nothing about the person behind that token. Protection at rest is not documented.

data_stores.name: schedule archive
data_stores.description: A folder where the importer writes each downloaded scheduling document.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive
data_stores.technology: folder on the corporate file store

data_flows.name: open dispatch console
data_flows.description: A duty engineer opens the dispatch console in a browser and receives the application from the corporate web host.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state how the engineer signs in.

data_flows.name: call dispatch API
data_flows.description: The dispatch console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.notes: The console and API are served from different origins. The API answers cross-origin, but allowed origins and credential handling are undocumented.
data_flows.data_description: dispatch console API requests and responses

data_flows.name: open WebSocket
data_flows.description: The dispatch console opens and holds a WebSocket to the dispatch API for live job status.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console also opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API and holds it open for live job status.
data_flows.notes: Whether the socket uses TLS, whether its handshake is authenticated, and whether the engineer's session is checked again after opening are undocumented.

data_flows.name: read and write data
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.data_description: job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and creating token or session data

data_flows.name: pull SOAP feed
data_flows.description: The schedule importer pulls the scheduling partner's planned-work feed.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every hour it pulls the partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS
data_flows.notes: The source does not state how the partner identifies the importer or how the importer identifies the partner.
data_flows.data_description: tomorrow's planned work in an XML document

data_flows.name: write schedule document
data_flows.description: The importer writes downloaded scheduling documents into the schedule archive on the corporate file store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive, a folder on the corporate file store.

data_flows.name: post work orders
data_flows.description: The schedule importer posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The importer then posts the parsed work orders to the same dispatch API the console calls.
data_flows.notes: The importer presents an API token. The token was issued when the importer was built and has not been rotated.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where duty engineers and the schedule importer are located, and where the corporate web host and file store are described.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: production control plane
trust_boundaries.description: The same-company zone holding the live estate, where an account can move a crew and change a depot's work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
trust_boundaries.notes: The control plane holds greater authority than a corporate laptop and is not reachable from the internet.

trust_boundaries.name: scheduling partner
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the scheduling partner, which is another company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database contains confidential data because it stores crew mobile numbers and token or session data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database holds crew mobile numbers and the token or session that created each job order; disclosure of personal data and credentials is confidential.

assumptions.assumption: The schedule importer is a non-web process because it is described as a recurring importer that pulls, parses, and posts documents.
assumptions.basis: The source describes a batch-style importer that runs hourly and parses an XML feed rather than a web application interface.
